amoxicillin clavulanate.purpose: Amoxicillin and clavulanic acid is used to treat certain infections caused by bacteria, including infections of the ears, lungs, sinus, skin, and urinary tract. Amoxicillin is in a class of medications called penicillin-like antibiotics.
amoxicillin clavulanate.usage: Amoxicillin and clavulanic acid comes as a tablet, a chewable tablet, and a suspension (liquid) to take by mouth. It is taken with a meal or snack every 8 to 12 hours (2 to 3 times a day). Take it around the same times every day.

acetaminophen.purpose: Acetaminophen is used to relieve mild to moderate pain and to reduce fever. Acetaminophen is in a class of medications called analgesics (pain relievers) and antipyretics (fever reducers).
acetaminophen.usage: Acetaminophen comes as a tablet, chewable tablet, capsule, suspension or solution (liquid), extended-release (long-acting) tablet, and orally disintegrating tablet (tablet that dissolves quickly in the mouth), to take by mouth, with or without food.

guaifenesin.purpose: Guaifenesin is used to relieve chest congestion. Guaifenesin may help control symptoms but does not treat the cause of symptoms or speed recovery.
guaifenesin.usage: Guaifenesin comes as a tablet, a capsule, an extended-release (long-acting) tablet, dissolving granules, and a syrup (liquid) to take by mouth. The tablets, capsules, dissolving granules, and syrup are usually taken with or without food every 4 hours as needed. The extended-release tablet is usually taken with or without food every 12 hours.

albuterol inhalation.purpose: Albuterol is used to prevent and treat difficulty breathing, wheezing, shortness of breath, coughing, and chest tightness caused by lung diseases such as asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD; a group of diseases that affect the lungs and airways).
albuterol inhalation.usage: Albuterol comes as a solution (liquid) to inhale by mouth using a special jet nebulizer (machine that turns medication into a mist that can be inhaled)

furosemide.purpose: Furosemide is used alone or with other medications to treat high blood pressure.
furosemide.usage: Furosemide comes as a tablet and as a solution (liquid) to take by mouth.

lisinopril.purpose: Lisinopril is used alone or in combination with other medications to treat high blood pressure in adults and children 6 years of age and older.
lisinopril.usage: Lisinopril comes as a tablet and a solution (liquid) to take by mouth.

metoprolol.purpose: Metoprolol is used to treat high blood pressure, angina (chest pain) and heart failure. Metoprolol also is used to improve survival after a heart attack .
metoprolol.usage: Metoprolol comes as a tablet, an extended-release (long-acting) tablet, and an extended-release capsule to take by mouth.

oxycodone.purpose: Oxycodone is used to relieve severe pain.
oxycodone.usage: Oxycodone comes as a solution (liquid), a tablet, a capsule, an extended-release (long-acting) tablet, and an extended-release capsule to take by mouth. Take the solution, tablet, and capsule with or without food every 4 to 6 hours as needed for pain.

ibuprofen.purpose: Prescription ibuprofen is used to relieve pain, tenderness, swelling, and stiffness caused by osteoarthritis (arthritis caused by a breakdown of the lining of the joints) and rheumatoid arthritis (arthritis caused by swelling of the lining of the joints).
ibuprofen.usage: Prescription ibuprofen comes as a tablet and suspension (liquid) to take by mouth.
